params.name: base
params.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the base currency. Defaults to USD if not specified.

params.name: symbols
params.description: Comma-separated list of currency codes to return rates for. If omitted, all supported currencies are returned.

items.docs: Returns real-time mid-market exchange rates for the specified base currency. Rates are sourced from central banks and financial institutions. Update frequency depends on plan tier.

params.name: date
params.description: The date for which to retrieve historical rates in YYYY-MM-DD format.

items.docs: Returns exchange rates for a specific historical date. CurrencyBeacon provides up to 30 years of historical data.

params.name: start_date
params.description: Start date of the time series in YYYY-MM-DD format.

params.name: end_date
params.description: End date of the time series in YYYY-MM-DD format.
